title: Sunday Funday Dip
ingredients: 2 Oz Taco Seasoning Packets (2 packets total)
instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.
Step 2: Cook the ground beef according to the directions on the back of the taco seasoning packet. Use two packets instead of one for extra flavor.
Step 3: Spread the cream cheese on the bottom of an 8 x 8" baking dish then add a layer of salsa.
Step 4: Add the taco-seasoned ground beef and sprinkle the top with shredded cheddar cheese.
Step 5: Place it in the oven for about 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the sides are hot and bubbly.
Step 6: Let it sit for 5-10 minutes. Garnish with parsley and enjoy with tortilla chips!
notes: From the recipe collection of Tara Ippolito. Can be made ahead of time — prep the layers, cover and refrigerate until ready to bake (add a few extra minutes if going straight from fridge to oven). Ground chicken or turkey can substitute for beef. For a spicier version, use hot taco seasoning, hot salsa, and pepper jack cheese.
